name: mold-v1-accessibility-lane
description: Accessibility lane harness for mold_fin. Lives beside the lane so nothing is installed into the immutable mold codebase.

scripts.vendor: npm pack axe-core@4.13.0 --pack-destination /tmp && tar -xzOf /tmp/axe-core-4.13.0.tgz package/axe.min.js > vendor/axe.min.js && rm -f /tmp/axe-core-4.13.0.tgz && node deps-check.mjs

comment: axe-core is vendored as vendor/axe.min.js (one standalone file, MPL-2.0) and injected with addScriptTag, so the lane needs no node_modules and no network at run time. Playwright is the VM-wide install; this lane never adds a dependency to molds/mold_fin/codebase.
